title: Powering Cybersecurity with GenAI & Intelligent Agents
takeaways: Introduction to the transformative role of Generative AI and autonomous agents in modern security operations.
Presented by Harsh Verma, Principal AI Engineer.

title: Agenda
takeaways: Outlines the 6-part roadmap for the presentation.
Covers topics from fundamental concepts to future trends and ethics.

title: The Evolution of Cyber Threats
takeaways: Traces progression from traditional rule-based security to agentic AI security.
Emphasizes the need to shift from reactive to proactive, autonomous defense.

title: Today's Cybersecurity Battlefield
takeaways: Highlights high threat frequency (every 39 seconds) and severe financial impact.
Notes long dwell times and dramatic increases in ransomware payments.

title: Al Agents Hierarchy of Needs
takeaways: Presents a structured hierarchy for building agentic security systems.
Addresses industry-wide challenges like malware volume and the skills gap.

title: Intelligent Agents: Beyond Traditional Automation
takeaways: Contrasts static, rule-based automation with dynamic, goal-driven Agentic AI.
Emphasizes self-learning and proactive threat hunting capabilities.

title: Where GenAI Meets Cybersecurity
takeaways: Defines the core cycle of Agentic AI: Detect, Analyze, Decide, Defend.
Focuses on autonomous systems that require minimal human intervention.

title: Understanding Agents in Cybersecurity
takeaways: Categorizes agents into Rule-Based, Learning, and Autonomous.
Examples include SIEM triggers, behavioral analytics, and self-healing networks.

title: Autonomous Cyber Defense in Action
takeaways: Introduces practical agent roles: Threat Intel Summarizers, SOC Sidekicks, and Deception Agents.
Focuses on real-time adaptation to attacker behavior.

title: Practical Applications in Cybersecurity
takeaways: Covers applications in threat detection, incident response, and secure development.
Highlights automated triage and code vulnerability remediation.

title: Case Study: Autonomous Incident Response
takeaways: Demonstrates a 94% reduction in Mean Time to Respond (MTTR) for a financial services provider.
Highlights the efficiency gain of freeing up analysts for strategic initiatives.

title: Challenges and Ethical Considerations
takeaways: Discusses technical hurdles like explainability and adversarial attacks.
Addresses ethical concerns regarding accountability and misuse.

title: Organizational Risks
takeaways: Identifies risks like overreliance on AI and legacy infrastructure integration.
Raises the question of the human role in the loop.

title: The Future Security Professional
takeaways: Outlines essential skills: AI literacy, prompt engineering, and agent supervision.
Reiterates that human expertise amplified by AI is the ultimate advantage.

title: Emerging Trends
takeaways: Projects a roadmap from 2024 to 2027+ for multi-agent systems and cognitive frameworks.
Lists core focus areas including agent orchestration and model evaluation.

title: Demo of Security rules configuration using Agent
takeaways: Showcases 'Rakshak-AI', a tool for defining secure network rules.
Demonstrates practical implementation of an intelligent network security agent.

title: Q & A
takeaways: Closing slide for audience interaction and discussion.
